title: Environment configuration outside source control
description: Configuration files ignored by source control or edited in place per environment, so the real production shape is not in the repository.

impact.summary: Configuration cannot be compared across versions without the production shape (values redacted).

handling.option: Ask the user for the production configuration shape (keys only, values redacted) and record it

checks.text: The production configuration keys are listed (no values) and mapped to the target
